content.text: Nancy Guthrie FAQs Who is Nancy Guthrie, and what is known about her disappearance? Answer: Nancy Guthrie is an 84-year-old woman who went missing from her Tucson, Arizona, home in early February 2026. Her home had a Ring Doorbell camera that captured a video of a male kidnapper. The FBI and Pima County Sheriff’s Department continue to look for evidence as to why Nancy Guthrie was taken. The Guthrie family has pleaded for her return, sharing updates and offering rewards to learn more about their mother’s mysterious disappearance. Who are Nancy Guthrie’s children: Annie, Savannah and Camron? Answer: Nancy Guthrie is the mother of three children: Annie Guthrie, Savannah Guthrie and Camron Guthrie. Annie Guthrie is a poet and is married to AP biology teacher Tommaso Cioni.Savannah Guthrie is well known for her role as a co-host on NBC’s “Today” show and is married to Mark Feldman. Camron Guthrie is a retired military colonel. What are the key pieces of evidence in the Nancy Guthrie case? Answer: In the missing persons case regarding Nancy Guthrie, a Nest camera video shows a masked man on her doorstep who appears to be carrying a stuffed backpack and a holstered gun. DNA from an unknown individual was found inside Guthrie’s home. Blood drops were also found on the front steps of the home. Guthrie’s pacemaker helped determine a potential timeline for her abduction when it lost connection to her smartphone. Investigators reviewed roadside surveillance and security cameras, as well as cell tower data and other digital forensic evidence. Who is the suspect in the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie? Answer: Nancy Guthrie is believed to have been abducted from her Catalina Foothills home. The FBI describes the suspect seen in surveillance images and video outside her front door around the time she vanished as a male between 5'9" and 5'10" tall with an average build, carrying a 25-liter “Ozark Trail Hiker Pack” backpack. Pima County Sheriff Chris Nanos said he has an idea of the motive behind the 84-year-old's disappearance but has not shared it publicly. A forensics expert who helped crack the Idaho student murders said digital evidence may hold the key to the Nancy Guthrie abduction case. Has law enforcement located Nancy Guthrie? Answer: As of early Spring 2026, the Pima County Sheriff’s Department and the FBI have not located Nancy Guthrie or named a suspect in her disappearance. Guthrie, mother of "Today" host Savannah Guthrie, has been missing from her home since the early hours of Feb. 1.
